semantics.function: q = b OR c; independent of a and d
semantics.timing: Continuous combinational response; no clock, cycles, stored state or specified propagation delay
semantics.initialization: No initialization or reset required; output determined by current inputs

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, signed interpretation, overflow, rounding, truncation or saturation

verification.oracle: Literal 16-entry truth table transcribed from original waveform, indexed by {a,b,c,d}; not computed from implementation expression
verification.coverage: Exhaustively check all 16 binary combinations forward and reverse to check changes and absence of retained state
verification.comparison: Case inequality after testbench settling delay; fatal on mismatch
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite shell and testbench timeouts
verification.gate: python3 validate_contract.py must PASS before RTL creation

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z input values and physical propagation delays is unspecified; binary waveform defines every binary input combination.
